info.name: Mishwark Backend API
info.description:
Mishwark car-rental & chauffeur booking backend.

AUTH: POST /auth/otp/verify returns a JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Role routing: Customer, Driver, Super Admin.

SETUP: set baseUrl=http://localhost:5000, then run Verify OTP and copy the token into {token}.
Dev OTP bypass: code="0000".

RESPONSE ENVELOPE: { success, data, pagination? }. Errors: { message, errorCode, errors }.

request.description: Create a customer or driver account. Multipart/form-data — fields may arrive as JSON strings or files. The `role` flag defaults to 'customer'; admin roles cannot be self-assigned.

Email/password sign-in, step 1. Limits: 5 wrong passwords for one account from one device (IP) block that device from that account for 15 minutes (429, `errors.retryAfterSeconds`); the owner on another device is unaffected. 403 for a disabled account. Never returns a session: it answers with the next step and a `loginToken` (signed, 5 minutes): `passwordChangeRequired` (temporary password: call /auth/set-password), `twoFactorSetupRequired` (with `secret` + `qrCodeDataURL`: call /auth/verify-2fa-setup) or `twoFactorRequired` (call /auth/verify-2fa). 400 on a wrong email or password.

request.description: One bookable car with photos (cover first), features and luggage. 404 if it doesn't exist, is retired or has no driver.

PUBLIC. Server-side price estimate. 400 for a retired car. Distance and duration are recomputed from startPoint/endPoint; any distanceKm you send is only reported back under `comparison` and never priced. Price overrides (customPricePerKm and friends) are rejected. Send the Bearer token to include the caller's own discounts (packageId of their active package; first-booking referral discount). Admins may pass customerId to quote for a customer. Response adds packageDiscount and referralDiscount.

PUBLIC. Resolves startPoint/endPoint (coordinates or a place name) into distanceKm and durationMinutes. Coordinates are passed through; free text is geocoded via OpenRouteService. Without ORS_API_KEY the server falls back to a straight-line estimate and says so in `source` and `warning`.

Creates a booking (PENDING). Only the car's own drivers can drive it: a chosen driver must be one of them (400 "This driver isn't assigned to this car"); otherwise the main driver is tried first, then the others. 400 "This car has no driver assigned yet", 400 on a retired car or a maintenance day, 409 when the car is too close to another trip or none of its drivers is free.
